scope: Read-only design review from a source packet; no delegated edits or tools
accepted: Durable operation ownership and reservation journal
Bind reviewed archive digest to prepared stage; preserve staged evidence
Release host snapshot lease before archive sealing/download
Reconcile dead-owner and lost-response state before retry
corrections: Retain already implemented client route/request contract; do not adopt proposed alternate routes
Upload seal uses ordered chunk commitment; whole archive digest is a separate returned identity
Target key stays in existing protected custody; encrypt journal payloads with it rather than persisting key material in an operation
Durable checking/sealing intent is allowed when owner-bound and recovered to interrupted after confirmed owner exit
Host pause and kill tests added after the design packet supersede its stale new-code checklist
remaining: Implement, integrate and test the public v2 coordinator, quota, HTTP and UI. Review output is not implementation proof.
